description: 企业技术专利竞争分析。当用户提到企业情报分析、竞争对手分析、竞品专利、技术竞争格局、专利布局对比、某家公司在做什么技术、行业专利态势，或要一份可交付的企业专利竞争报告时使用。常见说法：「竞品专利分析」「对手在布局什么」「某公司的专利布局」「技术情报」「专利尽调」。Use when the user asks for competitive patent intelligence, competitor technology analysis, or a company's patent landscape report. Also covers competitor patent analysis, technology intelligence, patent due diligence.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
